scripts.release: node -e "let v=process.argv[1]||''; if(/^\d+\.\d+$/.test(v)) v+='.0'; if(!/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(v)){console.error('Usage: npm run release 1.0.1'); process.exit(1)}; const {execSync}=require('child_process'); const remote=(execSync('git remote').toString().trim().split(/\s+/).includes('origin')?'origin':execSync('git remote').toString().trim().split(/\s+/)[0]); if(!remote){console.error('No Git remote configured'); process.exit(1)}; execSync('git tag -a v'+v+' -m \"Release v'+v+'\" 2>/dev/null || git tag -f -a v'+v+' -m \"Release v'+v+'\" && git push '+remote+' v'+v,{stdio:'inherit'})"
